name: GDG on Campus VinUniversity
description: Google Developer Group on Campus at VinUniversity is a student community in Hanoi that learns, builds and ships with technology, as part of the global Google Developer Groups network.
location: VinUniversity, Vinhomes Ocean Park, Gia Lam, Hanoi, Vietnam

pillars.title: Build your next self
pillars.text: Keep learning, find out what you are good at, and grow through things you have not tried before.

pillars.title: Build your next idea
pillars.text: Take an idea off the page, test it, and turn it step by step into a product that matters.

pillars.title: Build your next generation
pillars.text: Join the next generation of GDGoC VinUni: curious students who learn together and build the future of tech.

recruitment.closedMessage: Applications for Gen 4 closed on 8 November 2026. Follow our Facebook page to hear about the next round.

steps.title: Application
steps.text: Fill in the online form and pick the station that fits you.

steps.title: Email results
steps.text: Every applicant hears back by email. Check Spam and Promotions too.

steps.title: Interview
steps.text: A conversation with the department you applied to. We care about how you think more than a perfect answer.

steps.title: Welcome
steps.text: Final results, onboarding, and your first project with the team.
